Level1.levelGoal: Wipe out the enemy patrol and take their outpost

Level3.levelGoal: Silence the ridge — bunker and watch tower both

Level4.levelGoal: Clear the barracks and drop the comms mast

Level5.levelGoal: Cut the tower's legs — what stands on it falls with it

Level6.levelGoal: Break the assault before it reaches your line
